title: Norway · Trollstigen and Geiranger Switchbacks
slogan: A 137 km loop out of Trollstigen hairpins
story: Waterfalls, walls and road status that actually matters. 137 km round from Åndalsnes - plan on about 2 h 38 of riding. The stops in between: Valldal strawberry stop, Eagle Road and Geiranger fjord. Trollstigen hairpins is the high point. It tops out at about 1,150 m. Trollstigen is subject to seasonal closure - check it is open before you set off. It is a high-mountain day.

scenicChapters.narrative: Water arrives beside the road and stays for 2 km. The line follows the shore because there is nowhere else for it to go. Slow enough to look. The surface follows the shoreline, so the corners arrive where the water decided, not where an engineer did.
